scope: Selected final source visual review only; no ART, runtime or gameplay approval.
basis: Live Wang Lin same-direction anatomy/style/camera primary; same-NPC approved southeast identity supporting. Action corrections retain their own target identity.
frameNotation: Rows idle/talk/profession; frames 1-6 left to right. All 18 raw poses and the fixed-scale native root strip inspected per source.

orientation.finding: All 18 poses retain back-left orientation. Only left ear and narrow cheek contour are exposed; no eye or frontal face leaks through the hair. Camera corresponds to the live Wang northwest reference.

identity.finding: Grey compact bun, jade/gold hair ornament, ivory and smoky-green robe, waist jade and bamboo-scroll hint retain the approved Diệp Tĩnh identity.

anatomy.finding: Skull, body and attached sleeves stay coherent across rows. Front-of-abdomen palms are occluded by the torso in rear view; visible gesture hands stay at lateral silhouette edges. Fixed-scale native strip shows complete boots on the common floor with no adjacent-pose clipping.

limitations: The cultivation gesture is subdued from the rear; elbow and sleeve motion carry most of its reading.
Bamboo scroll remains a small shoulder-side hint at native scale.

orientation.finding: All 18 poses retain full back view with no visible eye or frontal face. Ear contour and hair ribbons correspond to rear orientation rather than a side-facing pose.

identity.finding: Dark bun, ivory ribbon with earthy-red tie, muted-jade robe, ivory apron cloth and brown held case remain coherent with the approved Tô Nhược identity across all rows.

anatomy.finding: Case-inspection hands and case are now occluded by the back robe rather than painted over its centre. Talk hands extend from the right sleeve at the silhouette; profession frame 4 shows only the lateral brush/hand at the right shoulder edge. Fixed-scale native strip keeps complete boots on the floor without clipping or detached limbs.

limitations: Case inspection is mostly hidden from the rear; sleeve/elbow movement and the brief lateral brush in profession frame 4 provide the visible cue.
The small brush is subtle at native scale and appears briefly rather than remaining prominently visible.

orientation.finding: Full back view retained throughout; no face, eye or front hand/hilt is painted over the centre of the rear robe.

identity.finding: Compact bun, navy robe, wrapped wrists and wooden sword remain coherent with approved Tạ Kiếm Sơn identity. Sword remains on screen right in all 18 poses.

anatomy.finding: Talk uses a visible head nod while the holding hand keeps the sword down. Profession tilts the blade outward at the flank. Source and fixed-scale root strip show attached limbs, stable ground contact and no crop/clipping.

limitations: Head nod lowers skull top by a few native pixels; this is pose movement under a shared scale.
Sleeve overlap makes the upper holding arm less explicit in profession frame 2.

orientation.finding: True back-left view with ear and narrow cheek contour; eyes are hidden. Head and torso remain northwest in all three rows.

identity.finding: Compact bun, facial-side hair contour, navy garment, wrapped wrists and wooden sword preserve Tạ identity. Sword remains continuously attached to the near holding hand in all 18 poses.

anatomy.finding: Talk nod and small wrist demonstration are real pose changes. No centre-back hand/hilt leakage; fixed-scale root strip shows planted feet, coherent head/body anatomy and complete silhouettes.

limitations: Sword grip and blade thickness vary slightly through profession frames 2-4; the continuous blade remains legible.

orientation.finding: True back-right view throughout; eyes stay hidden and the rear garment/head angle corresponds to live Wang northeast.

identity.finding: Compact bun, navy rear garment, wraps and wooden sword remain consistent. Sword stays exposed throughout talk and profession.

anatomy.finding: Holding arm and blade remain attached at the flank without front hands/hilt drawn over the back. Fixed-scale root strip shows stable foot contact, complete poses and coherent skull/body proportions.

limitations: Profession frames 2-4 rotate the sword through a broader arc than northwest, still reading as controlled wrist exercise.
Wrist and handle silhouette is simplified at native scale.

orientation.finding: True front-left three-quarter view with both eyes and broad front robe plane throughout all 18 poses; previous west-profile and southeast-camera errors are corrected.

identity.finding: Facial hair, compact bun, navy robe, wrapped cuffs and wooden sword retain Tạ identity. Sword remains visible through talk mouth/blink changes and profession.

anatomy.finding: Profession bends the holding forearm across the waist and returns to neutral with attached grip/blade. Fixed-scale root strip shows stable floor contact and complete coherent anatomy without clipping.

limitations: Eyebrow scar is not reliably legible at native scale.
Beard/hair contour and sword angle vary slightly through profession poses.

orientation.finding: All 18 poses retain front-left three-quarter reading: the far screen-left eye is smaller, the near screen-right ear is exposed, and face and front robe planes turn toward screen left. Both eyes and the broad apron remain visible; this corrects the previous west profile and southeast/right-facing sources.

identity.finding: Dark compact bun, ivory ribbon with earthy-red tie, muted-jade robe, ivory front apron, red tied book, small case and brush retain the same Tô Nhược identity as the approved southeast and own south/west supporting views. Case and book stay attached through speaking and inspection poses.

anatomy.finding: Skull and body proportions remain coherent in all rows. Talk extends the free brush hand from its sleeve; profession brings the case between attached hands and returns to neutral. Fixed-scale native root strip shows complete boots on the floor, stable shared body scale and no adjacent-pose clipping.

limitations: Southwest angle is shallower and more front-biased than the live Wang southwest reference; leftward face asymmetry and near-ear exposure distinguish it from the own full-south view, but the directional contrast is subtle at native scale.
The small brush and red case seal remain subtle at native scale; hand/brush silhouettes vary slightly across talk and inspection.
